newsitem.title: USA: ABI in suit vs TRW, Experian.
newsitem.headline: ABI in suit vs TRW, Experian.

text.p: An American Business Information Inc subsidiary said Wednesday it filed suit against TRW Inc and Great Universal Stores Plc's Experian Inc, claiming the companies violated a licensing agreement signed in December 1995.
The American Business subsidiary, Database America Cos Inc, said it filed the suit in the U.S. District Court for the District of New Jersey.
Database said it is seeking a court order prohibiting TRW and Experian from reselling its database and also order the companies to reclaim all data resold to third parties.
An Experian spokeswoman said she could not comment because the company had not yet been served with the suit or received the complaint.

Britain's Universal bought Experian, which was once part of TRW, in November last year from a group of investors, which included Bain Capital Inc and Thomas H. Lee Co. The transaction valued Experian at $1.7 billion.
